name: singlet_grn_tf_activity_scoring
title: TF activity scoring from a prior regulon network
description: Scores transcription factor activity per cell or pseudobulk sample from a signed prior regulon table. The default method ulm fits each regulon's signed weights by univariate regression and returns t-values; mlm, viper, aucell, gsva, waggr_wmean and waggr_wsum are alternatives. Writes activity matrices, p-values where the method has them, and optional top-fraction calls. Do not use it to infer new TF-target edges, or with a regulon table from another species.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

layer.description: Log-normalised layer, cells or pseudobulk samples by genes; raw counts must not be passed.

prior.description: Name of a regulon table stored as uns/regulon_<prior>, such as collectri_human or dorothea_human.

method.description: Scoring method. ulm is the default for signed weighted priors; aucell uses set membership only.

tmin.description: Minimum prior targets present in the layer for a regulon to be scored.

call_frac.description: Top fraction of TFs per observation written as binary calls; 0 writes no calls.

viper.description: Options for method viper (aREA with pleiotropy correction).

pleiotropy.description: Apply the shadow-regulon correction for targets shared with stronger regulators.

reg_sign.description: Two-sided significance threshold for regulators in the pleiotropy correction.

n_targets.description: Minimum shared targets before a regulator pair enters the pleiotropy correction.

penalty.description: Penalty applied to shared targets in the pleiotropy correction.

n_up.description: Top-ranked features used by the recovery curve; null uses ceil(0.05 G) clipped to [2, G].

seed.description: Seed for AUCell tie-break shuffles and waggr permutations; fixed for reproducibility.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. obsm/tf_activity_ulm. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Completed runs: method, prior, n_observations, n_regulons_scored, n_regulons_dropped_tmin, median_targets_matched, warnings. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
